name: Bakshi Christensen
original_name: バクシー・クリステンセン
source:
Even at a young age, Bakshi is ranked fairly high in the CR:5's rival gang, the Grave Diggers. With his unabashed bloodlust, Bakshi relishes in tormenting and violence, making him feared by both his enemies and his allies. Crude, rude and unhinged, Bakshi pretty much does whatever floats his boat- to the point that he sometimes even ignores his boss (the leader of the Grave Diggers) and acts on his own. 

Despite his wild appearance, Bakshi takes good care of himself (refusing to use drugs, drinking heavily, smoking, etc.) and is smarter than he looks, if not, sly. He is highly independent and competent at following through with his boss' orders (when he decides to). As a result of his independent spirit and self-confidence, Bakshi hardly has an underlings and moves on his own. Bakshi is a Grave Diggers member that the CR:5 learns to not take lightly. In Gian Carlo's Lucky Happy Life, it is shown that he has a fondness for cats. His signature weapons are his two shotguns.

[Source: [URL=http://www.tennenouji.net/product/03_luckydog1/charactor/index.html]Luckydog 1 official website[/URL].]
